none: PAS CAM-576423: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, AD335-341, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers and one standard. Obverse shows laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//[...]. Condition is fine. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.35g, diameter is 15.05mm
